raw_text: Fresh Rohingya displacement crisis at Bangladesh-Myanmar border. Tatmadaw-Arakan Army clashes in Rakhine driving new refugee wave. BGB fired warning shots near Teknaf. Cox's Bazar camps already at breaking point with 1M+ residents. India monitoring for secondary flows into northeast via Tripura and Mizoram. This crisis has no end in sight.
